wolfram.note: Thread[Rule[Tuples[{1,0},3], IntegerDigits[30,2,8]]] — Tuples[{1,0},3] has 8 elements but IntegerDigits[30,2,8] also has 8, so Thread should distribute Rule across both; ours produces a single KeyValuePair[Tuples[...], IntegerDigits[...]] instead of threading — Thread doesn't recognize Rule as a threadable 2-ary head here (its own List-arity check likely only fires for operands that are already List-headed, and Tuples stays a live call until materialized)
